t01_rule: PPC5R9_T01 reads only persisted generic intake state/history fields. It has no PPC fixture, TEST_RESULT, implementation, sealer, argv, exit-code, stdout, or transcript-producer claim.
fixture_rule: Before architecture ratification, each T02-T14 FIXTURE_SPEC freezes ordered finite axes, applicability/exclusion rules, canonical row encoder, exact positive and one-field-mutation counts, row IDs and set hash, exact output bytes or first-failure code, and a separately source-hashed independent set oracle. Post-ratification code may execute but cannot define or expand the universe.
pass_rule: Two independent CPU/no-model executors must each produce exactly the frozen row set and exact results. Any missing, extra, duplicate, reordered, stale, wrong-run/type/role/cardinality, unexpected output, first-failure divergence, count mismatch, oracle mismatch, or implementation disagreement fails.

tests.coverage: generic state is human_required with human_required=true, implementation_authorized=false; exact change/two interpretations/critique/consensus occur once; one awaiting_consensus-to-human_required history entry binds source-state and consensus hashes; no architecture ratification or PPC product exists
